visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair wearing a white graphic t-shirt and beige overalls is sitting on a light wood floor. In front of her is a large, open red suitcase. She is methodically placing several grey compression bags filled with neatly folded garments into the compartments of the suitcase. (2) The scene cuts between various states of packing. She contrasts an organized suitcase labeled as 'J person' with a chaotic, overflowing one labeled as 'P person'. She is seen pressing down on the lid of a suitcase filled with boxed snacks and souvenirs, struggling to close the zipper due to the bulk. (3) She holds a specific grey compression bag towards the camera, showing the brand name 'MAT PASSPORT'. She demonstrates the double-zipper system which physically compresses the clothes inside. She places a stack of uncompressed clothes next to a compressed bag to show the height difference. (4) The woman displays different sizes and colors of the bags, specifically navy and light grey versions. She points to the text overlays while maintaining a cheerful facial expression and waving her hands toward the viewers. The background is a clean, minimalist indoor setting with a beige curtain and light wood furniture.
